title: A Complete Characterization of Cartan Inclusions of Finite Dimensional $C^*$-algebras
summary: We give a complete characterization of Cartan inclusions of finite dimensional $C^*$-algebras in terms of their inclusion matrices. More precisely, for a unital inclusion $\mathcal{B}\subseteq\mathcal{A}$ with inclusion matrix $Λ=(Λ_{ij})$, where Cartan means that $\mathcal{B}$ is a \emph{generalised Cartan subalgebra} of $\mathcal{A}$ in the sense of Exel, we prove that the inclusion is Cartan if and only if \[ \sum_i Λ_{ij}\leq 1 \] for every $j$.
